glosses: to announce, to declare, to proclaim

examples.text: Nel ... oznajmiała zdala Stasiowi, co słoń robi...
examples.translation: Nel ... kept announcing to Staś from a distance what the elephant was doing...
examples.english: Nel ... kept announcing to Staś from a distance what the elephant was doing...

examples.text: — Nie jesteś beznadziejną przyjaciółką — oznajmiłam. — Jesteś moją najbliższą przyjaciółką.
examples.translation: "You aren't a hopeless friend," I declared. "You are my closest friend."
examples.english: "You aren't a hopeless friend," I declared. "You are my closest friend."

examples.text: Zegar oznajmił upływ kwadransa i przypomniał Catherine o innych obowiązkach.
examples.translation: The clock announced the passage of a quarter hour and reminded Catherine of her other obligations.
examples.english: The clock announced the passage of a quarter hour and reminded Catherine of her other obligations.

examples.text: Minister oznajmił także, że ... nie należy go krytykować.
examples.translation: The minister also declared that ... it was not appropriate to criticize it.
examples.english: The minister also declared that ... it was not appropriate to criticize it.

examples.text: – Niestety, nie zdał Pan – oznajmił egzaminator beznamiętnym głosem.
